bar_source.name: hfdatalibrary_clean_5min_1391tickers_2026-09-28
bar_source.schema: datetime (naive ET), Open/High/Low/Close (f64 split-adjusted), Volume (i64), source (str)

universe_construction_rule: Universe(t) = PIT S&P 500 membership on date t (from fja05680 reconstruction) MINUS Real Estate constituents (sector_etf == 'XLRE' in the sector_map) INTERSECT HF-available tickers (via TICKER_ALIASES adapter). Sector ETFs and SPY are NOT part of the ranking cross-section — they are benchmarks only.
rebrand_handling_rule: Rebrand events are NOT treated as real index churn. In PIT events they carry `is_rebrand=True`; downstream must not count them as add/remove. Adapter TICKER_ALIASES ensures callers can query the canonical modern symbol and receive the pre-rebrand history from the provider's on-disk file.

known_truncated_series.GEN (via NLOK): continuous → 2022-11-07; no continuation series in provider

fisv_fi_rename_status: FISV → FI rebrand on 2024-07-11 is NOT recorded in fja05680 changes file; adapter aliases FI→FISV manually. PIT membership still lists FISV post-2024.

sector_mapping.source: phase0/sector_map.py — Wikipedia S&P 500 constituents table (GICS Sector column)
sector_mapping.real_estate_rule: Any ticker with sector_map[ticker] == 'XLRE' is FILTERED OUT of the cross-section at the eligibility layer. Real Estate stocks do not appear in Phase 2 rankings. Rationale: XLRE is missing from the HF provider snapshot; excluding preserves the frozen hypothesis spec for 10 of 11 sectors without introducing external data or specification deviation. Coverage cost: ~3-6% of PIT observations.

trading_calendar.early_close_rule: Session length and expected bar count are read from `common.nyse_calendar` per session date, not assumed. Full sessions = 78 5-min bars (09:30-15:55 open); 13:00 ET early closes = 42 bars (Black Friday, July 3, Christmas Eve, occasional others). Decision times whose forward-horizon bar falls outside session_close are automatically ineligible on that session.

corporate_action_treatment: Provider ships split-adjusted OHLC. Verified on TSLA 2020-08-31 (5-for-1) and 2022-08-25 (3-for-1) — bar closes continuous through split boundaries. Dividend adjustment status unspecified by provider; treated as-is (Phase 4 will assess whether this is material).
missing_bar_policy: Missing 5-min bars are NEVER forward-filled. The reindexer (phase0.features.reindex_bars_to_grid) generates a full 78-bar grid per (ticker, session) and fills missing bars with NULL OHLCV. Downstream return computations propagate the null; eligibility rejects the row.
eligibility_rules: A (ticker, session, decision_bar) row is eligible iff ALL of: (a) ticker is in Universe(session) per the PIT + sector filter rule; (b) ticker's sector ETF has a non-null close on that (session, decision_bar); (c) trailing-lookback close coverage on the reindexed grid is >= 0.85; (d) decision-bar close for the ticker is not null; (e) target-horizon-bar close (decision_bar + 12 bars) is not null — which automatically drops early-close sessions where 14:00 ET is past close; (f) ticker is not past its provider truncation date (KNOWN_TRUNCATED_SERIES).
coverage_requirements: Per-session per-ticker coverage denominator = NYSE calendar's expected_bars (78 or 42), NOT max-observed heuristic. Per-ticker roll-up separates mean_coverage_all_sessions (over dataset calendar) from mean_coverage_active (over ticker's own first-to-last observed session range) — Phase 2 quality checks use the latter.
known_provider_gaps_and_exceptions:
1. XLRE absent — see REAL_ESTATE_POLICY above.
2. Recent S&P spinoffs absent from HF: GEHC (2023-01), KVUE (2023-08), VLTO (2023-09), GEV (2024-04), SOLV (2024-04), WBD (2022-04), KKR, LII, SMCI, PSKY. Any Phase 2 window containing these dates will not include these tickers even if PIT lists them. Impact bounded by HF coverage figures in phase1_pit/hf_coverage_by_year.parquet.
3. Pre-2001 PIT is untrustworthy (source note verified).
4. Pre-2003 HF data does not exist.
5. Bankruptcy-era ticker suffixes (LEHMQ, AAMRQ) may not match HF file names for pre-2010 delistings.
6. Volume series discontinuity at SOURCE_REGIME_BOUNDARY (~20-40x drop as IEX feed replaces consolidated). Non-issue for the frozen hypothesis which is price-based; would be an issue for volume-based features.
7. Session calendar gap: 3 weekend-spillover sessions (2002-12-07, 2002-12-08, 2009-01-10) in provider files are dropped by the audit.
phase_2_isolation_statement: No Phase 2 frozen-hypothesis performance metric (IC, decile spread, portfolio return, Sharpe, or any downstream signal statistic) was computed, inspected, or used to inform any value in this Phase 1 specification. Every parameter here — universe rule, coverage threshold, eligibility gate, Real Estate policy, source regime handling — was set on the basis of data integrity and preregistered hypothesis semantics only. The Phase 0 exploratory window 2026-07-02 → 2026-09-25 remains embargoed from every Phase 2 partition per the Phase 0F freeze.
